title: Release-triggered escrow deposit
objective: The release pipeline produces and transmits an escrow deposit (source, lockfiles, SBOM, schema, infrastructure templates, runbooks) on every production release and records the agent's receipt.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC

title: Automated deposit build verification
objective: An isolated build environment rebuilds each deposit and compares artifact digests to the production release; mismatches block the deposit receipt from being recorded as verified.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC

title: Reproducible builds with provenance
objective: Each release is built in a hermetic pipeline producing SLSA provenance, SBOM and reproducible artifact digests; releases without them are blocked.
implementing_systems: Praxis (provenance records; not a build system)

title: Dependency license and continuity gate
objective: SBOM license check fails the build on noncommercial-licensed components lacking a commercial license plus escrow or fork right, and on unpinned dependencies (CNV-GOV-009); Echelon-internal libraries are pinned by digest like external ones.
notes: Conditor is named in CNV-GOV-009 but does not appear in the current-state brief; its existence and capability are unverified.
